name: Fervo Energy Cape Station, Beaver County, Utah
description: 500 MW under construction (GeoBlocks 1-11); approximately 900 MW fully contracted with offtakers; GeoBlock 1 reached commercial operation 30 September 2026, about 100 MW of operating capacity expected by early 2027 and GeoBlocks 4-11 targeted for 2028 — the first greenfield enhanced-geothermal development to reach contractual commercial operation

sources.note: Fervo Energy projects page fast facts, read 2026-11-11; commercial-operation date confirmed by the Fervo press release of 16 October 2026 (fervoenergy.com newsroom)

notes: Status per card source: operating (GeoBlock 1), construction (rest)
